headline: Paraguay Guaraní Drops After Ueno Bank Fails
summary: Paraguay's guaraní fell about 12% in eight days following the failure of Ueno Bank and rising bond risk. Itaipu has turned to the public prosecutor to recover $182 million deposited in the bank.
why: Bank failures in emerging markets can trigger sharp currency depreciations and liquidity strains across related state and corporate entities, affecting local financial stability.
